feeds.sourceDescription: Fetches AlienVault OTX subscribed pulses and imports Reports with associated malware, adversaries, and indicators into ThreatConnect via batch.

note: Fetches AlienVault OTX subscribed pulses and imports Reports with associated malware, adversaries, and indicators into ThreatConnect via batch.

params.label: ThreatConnect Owner
params.name: tc_owner
params.note: The destination Owner in the ThreatConnect Platform.

params.label: Last Modified
params.name: last_modified
params.note: modified_since cursor. Use a relative expression (e.g. 30 days ago) for the first run, or an ISO-8601 datetime. Empty falls back to 30 days. After a successful run the job writes an ISO cursor via results.tc for the next execution.

params.label: ThreatConnect Threat Rating
params.name: tc_threat_rating
params.note: Threat rating applied to imported indicators (0-5).
